description: Mzansi Amanzi is a web service that inventories all surface water across South Africa every month, from small farm dams and pans to large impoundments, with the associated dam volumes. It is built on 20 m Sentinel-2 imagery, which maps water bodies larger than about 0.25 hectares, using modelling procedures developed by GeoTerraImage and Ekosource, who keep the intellectual property, and delivered as National Water Quantity information to the South African National Space Agency. The viewer searches by quaternary catchment or dam and shows monthly water, long-term extent and occurrence. Coverage is South Africa for January 2016 to June 2022 under the contract. The viewer is public and online; the GIS data can be obtained from SANSA only by government departments and their contractors. Caveats: the licence forbids public dissemination and requires contractors to delete the data after the work, and the series covers the contract period. Simulation uses: reservoir storage and drought monitoring for water supply and irrigation planning. Related records: the Global Dam Tracker (data-gdat-global-dam-tracker) and Global Dam Watch (data-global-dam-watch-database).
